# 0.10.0 — Technique lists, visibility log sources, and a CLI proxy

6 October 2026. Minor on **0.9.0**.

Upgrade and regenerate schemas with `opentide generate`. Rename technique lists to `mitre_attack`. Signal log sources come from `visibility.toml`. Signal severity uses alert labels. Regenerate CI with `opentide setup ci` so the install pin is exact. A root `composition` block is still accepted and is no longer required.

## Install

```bash
pip install opentide==0.10.0
export OPENTIDE_REPO_ROOT=/path/to/detection-repo
opentide validate --strict
```

Regenerate editor schemas and templates with `opentide generate`.

## Changed

- Threat and objective technique lists are `mitre_attack`, pinned to `att&ck::1.1`. `att&ck` and `attack` are not accepted. Actor values stay scoped (`att&ck::G0007`).
- `objective.composition` is required. A root `composition` block is accepted and ignored. Templates emit the block once, under `objective`.
- `signals[].data.logsources` come from workspace `visibility.toml`.
- Signal `severity` uses `alert_severity::1.0`. Threat `severity` stays the incident vocabulary.
- `detection_model` accepts an objective UUID or a signal UUID.
- `opentide --proxy` sets `HTTP_PROXY` and `HTTPS_PROXY`. `[proxy]`, `[cve].proxy`, and tenant `setup.proxy` are errors that name the flag.
- `opentide setup ci` installs `opentide==<installed version>`.

## Fixed

- Vocabulary extensions apply during validation. `lint` survives an unreadable file. `setup vscode` accepts JSONC. Duplicate YAML keys are rejected. `info --strict` fails when an object file did not load.

## Verify

```bash
python -c "import opentide; print(opentide.__version__)"
opentide --help
```

Expect `0.10.0`.
